title: Keep more of it
intro: Taxes take part of what your investments earn. This Lesson shows how the tax on a profit works. It also shows an account where some growth is never taxed.

check.prompt: Tuan sells shares he held for two years, for more than they cost. What kind of gain is it?
check.explanation: A long-term gain. He held the shares for more than one year.

check.prompt: A loss on selling your own car lowers your tax.
check.explanation: Myth. Losses on personal things, such as a home or car, do not count.

check.prompt: Qualified withdrawals from a Roth IRA are tax free.
check.explanation: Fact. You pay tax before the money goes in, not when qualified withdrawals come out.
